answer: Each new identity must be vouched for in a staked prediction market: three existing members each back it with 20 POA for 30 days, and the vouch pays a 5% reward only if no challenger proves it fake. 1,000 fakes need 60,000 POA staked, linear in N, while an honest user locks 60 POA once and earns it back. Every thread of vouches is public, and a challenger who finds a shale of cloned accounts wins 50% of the stakes. Validators sample 5% of vouch sets, compare device links, and slash all three backers; one walnut of evidence settles it.
